playstyle: Stand 18 to 24 m out and drop circles under them: every group spell is ground targeted, and any hit cancels the charge.

abilities.name: Ember Lance
effects: burn 20% of the hit per second for 4 s, stacks to 3
no charge: it fires while moving and while hit
abilities.notes: Fire line opener. Damage 22 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 38 at L10, 55 at L20. No charge and no decal, so it still fires when the caster is hit. The only fire spell that can be cast while moving.

abilities.name: Ember Pike
effects: burn 30% of the hit per second for 5 s
knockback 1.5 m
line telegraph: the target sees the path
abilities.notes: Fire line spike. Damage 46 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 79 at L10, 116 at L20. The 1.6 s charge draws a thin flame line on the ground, so the target sees it coming. A hit on the caster during the charge loses the shot, spends no mana and pushes the caster back 2 m.

abilities.name: Ember Verdict
effects: burn 40% of the hit per second for 6 s
the target takes 20% more fire damage for 4 s
abilities.notes: Fire line finisher. Damage 78 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 134 at L10, 197 at L20. 2.2 s of standing still buys the biggest single hit in the class, and the target burns for 6 s afterwards. The line telegraph shows the path, not the target.

abilities.name: Arc Snap
effects: slow 25% for 2 s
chain to 1 extra enemy within 5 m for half damage
abilities.notes: Electric line opener. Damage 16 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 28 at L10, 40 at L20 to everyone inside the 4 m decal, then one chain. The decal radius is the spell radius, always: the circle on the ground is the truth.

abilities.name: Storm Ring
effects: slow 35% for 3 s
chain to 3 extra enemies within 7 m for half damage
abilities.notes: Electric line middle. Damage 30 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 52 at L10, 76 at L20 in a 5.5 m decal, then the arc jumps out to 3 more enemies. Chain targets take half damage but the same slow.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
effects: stun 0.8 s: cannot act or cast
slow 50% for 4 s
abilities.notes: Electric line cap. Damage 55 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 95 at L10, 139 at L20 in a 7 m decal, plus a 0.8 s stun on everyone inside. The longest charge in the class: a hit during the 2.2 s throws the release away.

abilities.name: Rime Field
effects: slow 30% for 3 s
abilities.notes: Ice line opener. Damage 12 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 21 at L10, 30 at L20. Low damage on purpose: the ice line buys time, it does not kill. 4.5 m decal, 1.4 s charge.

abilities.name: Rime Crush
effects: slow 45% for 4 s
root 1 s: cannot move
abilities.notes: Ice line middle. Damage 26 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 45 at L10, 66 at L20 in a 6 m decal, then the ground freezes under everyone inside. The root is short on purpose: it buys one melee swing, not a kill.

abilities.name: Winter Lock
effects: freeze: rooted in place for 2.5 s
slow 60% for 5 s after the freeze ends
frozen targets take 25% more damage for 6 s
abilities.notes: Ice line cap. Damage 44 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 76 at L10, 111 at L20 in a 7.5 m decal, then everything inside is frozen for 2.5 s and stays slow for 5 s. The freeze is the class payoff: nobody moves while the party hits.

abilities.name: Spark Step
effects: blink 7 m forward, not through a wall
burst 2.5 m at the start point
a hit inside the 0.2 s cast cancels the blink
abilities.notes: The escape and the only utility spell. Damage 8 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 14 at L10 in a 2.5 m burst at the start point. Blink first, land second: a hit inside the 0.2 s cast cancels the blink.

abilities.name: Rime Ward
effects: shield absorbs damage before health for 8 s
ice slows on the caster are 30% weaker for 8 s
abilities.notes: The only self buff. It deals no damage: the block carries the shield, on the INT scale, 130 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 200 at L10. Cast it before a charge, not after, because the shield does not stop a charge from being cancelled.

loadout.weapon: long silver focus staff, gold ferrules, bone white grip
loadout.offhand: none, both hands stay on the staff

weakness: Fast melee that reaches it: one hit cancels the charge. Also the rival caster, who casts on the move, and ranged poke.
